description: Free browser games. No download, no signup, no launcher. Click and play instantly.

selfHosted.title: Daily Five
selfHosted.description: One five-letter word, six guesses, a new puzzle every day at midnight. Green means the letter is in the right place, amber means it is in the word but somewhere else. Build a streak and share your grid without spoiling the answer.
selfHosted.instructions: Type a five-letter word and press Enter. Green = right letter, right spot. Amber = right letter, wrong spot. Six tries.

selfHosted.description: Slide the numbered tiles with the arrow keys. Two tiles of the same number merge into their sum. Keep merging until you reach 2048 - then keep going and see how far past it you can get.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys to slide all tiles in one direction. On a phone, swipe.

selfHosted.title: HexGL
selfHosted.description: A futuristic anti-gravity racer built in WebGL. You pilot a ship down a neon canyon track at absurd speed, scraping walls and hunting a clean lap. One of the best-looking games that runs in a browser tab.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to steer. Shift to boost, space to brake.

selfHosted.title: Astray
selfHosted.description: A 3D maze rendered in WebGL with real physics. Tilt the floor to roll a marble through the passages and find the exit. Simple to start, genuinely fiddly by the later mazes.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys to tilt the maze and roll the ball toward the exit.

selfHosted.title: SkiFree
selfHosted.description: The endless downhill skier from the old Windows entertainment pack, rebuilt in JavaScript. Dodge trees and rocks, go as far as you can, and try to outrun the yeti that eventually comes for you.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys or click where you want to go. F to speed up.

selfHosted.title: Particle Clicker
selfHosted.description: An idle game where you run a particle physics lab. Click to gather data, hire researchers, upgrade the detector, and unlock discoveries. Built by physicists at CERN's summer school, so the science underneath it is real.
selfHosted.instructions: Click the detector to collect data. Spend it on staff and upgrades.

selfHosted.title: Asteroids
selfHosted.description: The 1979 vector arcade cabinet, rebuilt in HTML5 canvas. Rotate, thrust, and shoot the rocks apart - each hit splits them into faster, smaller pieces. Pure momentum and no brakes.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys to rotate and thrust. Space to fire.

selfHosted.title: Drakonas
selfHosted.description: A vertical scrolling shooter in the arcade tradition - waves of enemies, weapon pickups, and a screen that fills with bullets. Runs on WebGL with a proper soundtrack.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to fly. Space to fire.

selfHosted.title: Blockfall
selfHosted.description: A configurable falling-block puzzle - you can change the board size, the piece set and the gravity before you start.
selfHosted.instructions: Arrow keys to move and rotate. Space to hard drop.

selfHosted.title: Tower Defense
selfHosted.description: Place towers along a winding path and stop the waves before they reach the end. Upgrade between rounds and watch your money.
selfHosted.instructions: Click a spot to build. Click a tower to upgrade or sell it.

selfHosted.title: Space Shooter
selfHosted.description: A top-down arcade shooter. Waves of enemies, power-ups, and a screen that gets busier the longer you last.
selfHosted.instructions: Mouse or arrow keys to move. Space to fire.

selfHosted.title: Breakout
selfHosted.description: The brick breaker. Bounce the ball off your paddle, clear every brick, and don't let it past you.
selfHosted.instructions: Mouse or arrow keys to move the paddle.

selfHosted.title: Ball and Wall
selfHosted.description: A brick breaker with power-ups and a long level list. Same core as Breakout, more toys.
selfHosted.instructions: Mouse to move the paddle. Click to launch.

selfHosted.title: Snake
selfHosted.description: Eat, grow, and don't hit yourself. The rule set that has outlived every console it appeared on.

selfHosted.title: Beatrix
selfHosted.description: A rhythm puzzle. Match the pattern by hitting the right beat at the right moment.
selfHosted.instructions: Keyboard keys in time with the beat.
